nodes.label: Ponytail Lazy Senior Dev Mode
nodes.rationale: Prioritize YAGNI, standard library, native platform features, already-installed dependencies, and one-liners. Write the minimum code that works. Avoid unrequested abstractions, new dependencies, boilerplate. Prefer deletion over addition.

nodes.label: Product Purpose
nodes.rationale: Provide a live, trusted view of who is where, help groups organize routes and progress together, and make sharing achievements effortless. Success is clear situational awareness, easy coordination, and confidence while moving.

nodes.label: Design Principles
nodes.rationale: Map-first clarity over visual effects, group presence obvious at a glance, athletic/grounded progress, direct/quick/reliable actions, and strong contrast/readable text sizes.

nodes.label: Real-Time Tracking
nodes.rationale: Uses Go channel concurrency to safely manage connections and groups without mutexes. In-memory caching replays location to late joiners. Server overwrites client values to prevent spoofing. Rates are limited and inputs validated.

nodes.label: Real-Time Chat & Media Architecture
nodes.rationale: Hybrid communication pipeline combining REST (multipart upload for images) and persistent WebSockets (text and events). Content headers are sniffed to restrict payloads to images. Randomized hex filenames prevent traversal. Optimistic client rendering tracks message state.
